##### Project general facts

Weybridge Gardens by LEOS Developments is a brand new residential community that effortlessly combines timeless contemporary architecture with the very best in modern design. Designed and developed in the UK, this iconic community is home to a collection of well-appointed studios and one bedroom apartments arranged across eleven elegant residential storeys. Every apartment has been cleverly designed to offer spacious, functional living areas with sunny private terraces, making it a wonderful choice for young professionals, homebuyers and investors alike.

Residents at Weybridge Gardens are truly spoilt for choice, with a gorgeous rooftop crowned by a climate-controlled infinity pool, a lovely pool deck with beautiful cabanas, in-water loungers, shaded seating areas, pool aerobics and a dedicated kids' swimming experience. The rooftop also hosts an outdoor cinema for themed movie nights, a serene Zen Japanese garden, landscaped areas, an urban farm, the Bella Napoli Pizzeria, the Smoke House BBQ and the Himalayan Tea Kiosk. Indoors there is a state-of-the-art gymnasium, the LEOS Boxing Academy, the LEOS Dance Studio, the LEOS Da Vinci Art Academy, the Como Lounge Cafe and a stylish co-working space, all complemented by a modern lobby with 24 hour security, private and guest valet parking, an AI supermarket, a multi-purpose events space and the Concierge by LEOS App.

Inside, bright and sunny living rooms enjoy high ceilings and premium quality porcelain floor tiles throughout, with expansive open plan living and dining areas that connect directly to a beautiful sunny terrace. The open plan modern kitchens are finished in neutral colour palettes with quartz worktops, custom-made cabinets and stainless steel sinks, and some apartments incorporate a breakfast bar area. Timeless modern bathrooms complete the picture with spacious walk-in showers, tiled shower enclosures and branded wash basins, while one bedroom homes offer a separate private master bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, fully-fitted wardrobes and direct access to the terrace.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Land Residence Complex, a sprawling and diverse community offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities, this exceptional location is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts with Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and Legoland Water Park, providing endless fun and entertainment for families.

The location is distinguished by its variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community features renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits. This vibrant community caters to residents and visitors of all ages, making it a unique destination in Dubai.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Land Residence Complex delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, sporting facilities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
